name: Archetypes -> Patterns -> Tools: generalizing pattern discovery and tool creation, with Opal as dogfood
description: Andrew-direct charter 2026-07-23 (verbatim in PRD s.0): use the entire system as dogfood and ask what the archetypes are -- dataflows, properties, interactions -- using the ratified C0-C3 ontology in infra/system/ontology + the rule bank; then establish where the various patterns live; then generalize pattern discovery and tool creation/registration/testing. Includes the stability-grader constraint (Andrew): regex is unstable in general, but where a pattern is STABLE BY LAW a tool-behind-the-tool should grade pattern stability and thereby design stable pattern-based tools. Successor/consumer of NFRA_MSBEFF's evidence.
phase: Phase 0 COMPLETE 2026-07-23: chartered. Substrate fixed (NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK C0-C3 ladder + ROLE/RELATION/TYPE axes + VARIANCE + the PSTMRT-added COMPLETENESS axis; infra/system/ontology/; motif catalog; GENESIS SDK as the proven abstraction precedent). Three questions set: archetype census (dogfood the ladder on ourselves, starting from CVO~Z tick-29's honest uncovered-edge gap) -> pattern inventory (pattern -> archetype -> instantiating tools -> gaps, seeded from 83 tools + 718 MSBEFF findings + 187 rail-override intents) -> generalize discovery/creation/registration/testing. s.3 stability grader: GOVERNANCE/CHURN/POPULATION/VIOLATION/BLAST axes; STABLE-BY-LAW permits a pattern extractor that MUST cite the law it depends on (a change to the law then fails loudly); anything less requires structural extraction. Sequenced BEHIND the MSBEFF R-series builds (which land the coverage/vintage/registration contracts ARCHTOOL synthesis must emit into).
